content.text: {"answer":"ambiguous","citations":["D046","D047"],"explanation":"The March pilot CRM labels CFO Pavel Ruud as decision maker with final sign-off, while the May 2 kickoff follow-up identifies COO Ines Barrow as the real operational decision maker, with the CFO only as budget approver. The wiki preserves both claims without saying which one supersedes the other, so no single decision maker can be established."}
